code: library(dMod2) dir.create("build", showWarnings = FALSE) # generated sources and shared objects in build/, reused when nothing changed options(dMod2.outdir = "build") cores <- max(1L, min(20L, parallel::detectCores() - 2L)) nstart <- 100L  # fits are saved in results/cache.rds under a key and read from there when present; delete the # file to fit everything again cached <- function(key, expr) {   file <- "results/cache.rds"   dir.create("results", showWarnings = FALSE)   store <- if (file.exists(file)) readRDS(file) else list()   if (is.null(store[[key]])) {     store[[key]] <- expr     saveRDS(store, file)   }   store[[key]] } # a fit of em() cached without the model, which an evaluation at the fit estimates restores cachedEm <- function(key, obj, random, start, control = list(), ...) {   model <- c("design", "prdfn", "errfn", "data")   f <- cached(key, { f <- em(obj, random, start, control = control, ...); f[model] <- NULL; f })   f[model] <- em(obj, random, f$argument, control = modifyList(control, list(trustControl = list(iterlim = 0))),                  verbose = FALSE)[model]   f }  dm <- c("forward", "reverse", "forward-reverse")

title: Target-mediated drug disposition
text: Five dose groups 9 subjects, samples one hour eight weeks; clearance, central volume target level vary subjects 20% CV, readings 15% log scale. seed gives typical draw: share censored readings median seeds 1 50. free drug log10 coordinates, C = 10^C_l10: stays positive binding takes far absolute tolerance solver, log(C) linear state.
code: truth <- log(c(CL = 0.3, V = 3, Q = 0.2, Vp = 3, kon = 5, koff = 0.25, kint = 15, kdeg = 15, R0 = 0.1)) omega <- sqrt(log(1 + 0.2^2)) sigma <- sqrt(log(1 + 0.15^2)) doses <- c(10, 30, 100, 300, 1000) times <- c(1 / 24, 1, 3, 7, 14, 21, 35, 56) lloq <- 0.1 subjects <- sprintf("S%02d", 1:45) table <- data.frame(ID = subjects, dose = rep(doses, each = 9), row.names = subjects) ode <- log10Transform(as.eqnvec(net), states = "C") ode #> Idx Inner <- Outer #>   1 C_l10 <- (-CL/V-Q/V-R*kon+Cp*Q/((10^(C_l10))*V)+RC*koff/(10^(C_l10)))/log(10) #>   2    Cp <- 1*(Q*(10^(C_l10)))*(1/Vp)-1*(Q*Cp)*(1/Vp) #>   3     R <- -1*(kon*(10^(C_l10))*R)+1*(koff*RC)+1*(ksyn)-1*(kdeg*R) #>   4    RC <- 1*(kon*(10^(C_l10))*R)-1*(koff*RC)-1*(kint*RC) # solver tolerances 1e-10: at the defaults the solver error moves -2 log L by about 1e-4, more than # FOCEI resolves, and the fit stalls short of the optimum x <- Xs(odemodel(ode, modelname = "tmdd", compile = FALSE, deriv2 = TRUE, derivMode = dm),         options = list(atol = 1e-10, rtol = 1e-10)) g <- Y(c(lcp = "log(10) * C_l10"), x, modelname = "tmdd_g", compile = FALSE, deriv2 = TRUE, derivMode = dm) e <- Y(c(lcp = "sigma"), g, attachInput = FALSE, modelname = "tmdd_e", compile = FALSE, deriv2 = TRUE, derivMode = dm) trafo <- branch(define(NULL, "x <- x", x = c("CL", "V", "Q", "Vp", "kon", "koff", "kint", "ksyn", "kdeg",                                              "C_l10", "Cp", "R", "RC", "sigma")), table = table) trafo <- insert(trafo, "x <- y", x = c("C_l10", "Cp", "RC"), y = c("log10(dose / V)", "0", "0")) trafo <- insert(trafo, paste("R <-", steady[["R"]])) trafo <- insert(trafo, "ksyn <- kdeg * R0") trafo <- insert(trafo, "dose <- d", d = dose) trafo <- insert(trafo, "x <- exp(x)", x = c(parameters, "sigma")) trafo <- insert(trafo, CL + V + R0 ~ 1 + (1 | ID)) p <- P(trafo, method = "explicit", modelname = "tmdd_p", compile = FALSE, deriv2 = TRUE, derivMode = dm) compile(x, g, e, p, output = "tmdd_all") random <- randomEffects(p)  simulateData <- function(seed) {   set.seed(seed)   eta <- matrix(rnorm(45 * 3, 0, omega), 45, dimnames = list(subjects, c("CL", "V", "R0")))   pars <- c(truth, sigma = log(sigma),             setNames(as.vector(eta), paste0("eta_", rep(colnames(eta), each = 45), "_", subjects)))   pred <- (g * x * p)(times = times, pars = pars, deriv = FALSE)   do.call(rbind, lapply(subjects, function(s) {     v <- pred[[s]][match(times, pred[[s]][, "time"]), "lcp"] + rnorm(length(times), 0, sigma)     data.frame(name = "lcp", time = times, value = pmax(v, log(lloq)), sigma = NA_real_, lloq = log(lloq),                condition = s, ID = s, dose = table[s, "dose"])   })) } censored <- vapply(1:50, function(s) mean(simulateData(s)$value <= log(lloq)), 0) seed <- which.min(abs(censored - stats::median(censored))) c(seed = seed, censored = censored[seed], median = stats::median(censored)) #>       seed   censored     median  #> 10.0000000  0.2222222  0.2222222 sim <- simulateData(seed) data <- as.datalist(sim, splitBy = "condition", keepCovariates = c("ID", "dose")) plotData(data) + ggplot2::aes(color = factor(dose)) +   ggplot2::labs(x = "time [days]", y = "ln free drug [nmol/L]", color = "dose [nmol]")

rbind(init, t(vapply(seq_len(nstart - 1L), function(i) init + rnorm(length(init), 0, 0.5), init))) runs <- cached("dMod2", do.call(rbind, unlist(lapply(c(focei = "focei", quadrature = "quadrature"), function(method)   parallel::mclapply(seq_len(nrow(starts)), function(i) {     options(dMod2.cores = 1L)     t <- system.time(f <- tryCatch(em(obj, random, starts[i, ], method = method, control = ctrl, verbose = FALSE),                                    error = function(e) NULL))[["elapsed"]]     data.frame(method = method, start = i, value = if (is.null(f)) NA_real_ else f$value, title: Bile acid transport
code: # Multistart ---- # distributedComputing() saves the objects named in `input`, copies them with the # code and the shared objects of the model to a job folder in the working # directory and runs the code there in the background, as one task on the local # machine. In the task, `cores` holds the cores of `on`, and mstrust() runs ten # fits per core. It needs a Unix-like system; on Windows, call mstrust() itself # with `cores = .cores`. ?distributedComputing shows how to send the same code to # other machines with sshNodes() or to a SLURM cluster with slurmCluster(). job <- distributedComputing(   mstrust(obj, pouter, sd = 4, fits = 10 * cores, cores = cores),   on = localNode(.cores), jobname = "ba_fits", input = c("obj", "pouter") ) job  # wait() reports the tasks done, running or failed until none runs. get() joins # the parlists of the tasks; purge() deletes the job folders. job$wait(interval = 5) fits <- as.parframe(job$get()) job$purge(local = TRUE) plotValues(fits)

title: Bile acid transport
text: profiles S, TCA_CELL TCA_CANA flat data. steady-state start canaliculi fixed scale remove direction:
code: # Steady state ---- # The canaliculi start in balance with the cells, at the reflux of closed # junctions, since they open only at time 0. The scale is fixed to 1, which # removes the direction. trafo <- eqnvec() |>   define("x <- x", x = innerpars) |>   define("TCA_buffer <- 0") |>   define("TCA_cana <- TCA_cell*k_export_cana/k_reflux") |>   insert("x <- 10^y", x = .currentSymbols, y = toupper(.currentSymbols)) |>   branch(conditions = c("closed", "open")) |>   define("k_reflux <- 10^K_REFLUX_OPEN", conditionMatch = "open") |>   insert("S <- 0") p <- P(trafo, modelname = "ba_trafo_ss", compile = TRUE)  outerpars <- getParameters(p) pouter    <- structure(rep(-1, length(outerpars)), names = outerpars) obj  <- normL2(data, g*x*p, attrName = "data") +   constraintL2(pouter, sigma = 20, attrName = "prior")  # `wait = TRUE` waits for the tasks, returns their results and deletes the job. fits <- distributedComputing(   mstrust(obj, pouter, sd = 4, fits = 10 * cores, cores = cores),   on = localNode(.cores), jobname = "ba_fits_ss", input = c("obj", "pouter"),   wait = TRUE ) plotValues(fits) bestfit <- as.parvec(fits)  profiles <- profile(obj, bestfit, whichPar = names(bestfit), method = "integrate",                     cores = .cores, limits = c(lower = -5, upper = 5),                     stepControl = list(stop = "data"),                     algoControl = list(reoptimize = TRUE)) plotProfile(profiles, mode %in% c("data", "prior")) # Fixed reflux ---- # K_REFLUX_OPEN stays practically non-identifiable: the profile is open towards # instantaneous reflux, so the reflux of open junctions is fixed to a fast rate. # K_EXPORT_SINUS stays open towards slow export below the 68% level. trafo <- eqnvec() |>   define("x <- x", x = innerpars) |>   define("TCA_buffer <- 0") |>   define("TCA_cana <- TCA_cell*k_export_cana/k_reflux") |>   insert("x <- 10^y", x = .currentSymbols, y = toupper(.currentSymbols)) |>   branch(conditions = c("closed", "open")) |>   define("k_reflux <- 10^6", conditionMatch = "open") |>   insert("S <- 0") p <- P(trafo, modelname = "ba_trafo_final", compile = TRUE)  obj     <- normL2(data, g*x*p, attrName = "data") bestfit <- trust(obj, bestfit[getParameters(p)], rinit = 1)$argument #+ fig.height = 3.5 plot((g*x*p)(times, bestfit, deriv = FALSE), data) + labs(color = "junctions")  # the parameters with their 95% confidence intervals, on log10 profiles <- profile(obj, bestfit, whichPar = names(bestfit), method = "integrate",                     cores = .cores, limits = c(lower = -5, upper = 5),                     algoControl = list(reoptimize = TRUE)) confint(profiles, level = 0.95)

title: Bile acid transport
code: # Prediction profile ---- # The cellular bile acid at time t becomes a parameter v, tied to the model by a # data point with a small sigma. Along the profile of v the data term is the # prediction profile, and the profile interval the confidence interval of the prediction. .predict <- function(t) {   objv <- normL2(data, g*x*p, times = t, attrName = "data") +     datapointL2(name = "cellular", time = t, parameter = "v", sigma = 0.1,                 attrName = "validation", condition = "closed")   pred <- (g*x*p)(t, bestfit, deriv = FALSE)[["closed"]]   v0   <- unname(pred[pred[, "time"] == t, "cellular"])   fit  <- trust(objv, c(v = v0, bestfit), rinit = 1)   profile(objv, fit$argument, "v", method = "integrate",           stepControl = list(stop = "data"),           algoControl = list(reoptimize = TRUE)) }  prof20 <- .predict(20) plotProfile(prof20, mode %in% c("validation", "data")) + labs(x = "cellular bile acid at t = 20") confint(prof20, val.column = "data")  # the interval at several times, drawn as a band around the prediction .band <- do.call(rbind, lapply(c(0:10, seq(12.5, 50, by = 2.5)), function(t)   data.frame(time = t, confint(.predict(t), val.column = "data")[c("lower", "upper")])))  .pred <- subset(as.data.frame((g*x*p)(times, bestfit, deriv = FALSE)),                 condition == "closed" & name == "cellular") ggplot(.pred, aes(time, value)) +   geom_ribbon(data = .band, aes(x = time, ymin = lower, ymax = upper),               inherit.aes = FALSE, alpha = 0.3) +   geom_line() +   geom_point(data = .band, aes(y = lower), shape = 4) +   geom_point(data = .band, aes(y = upper), shape = 4) +   theme_dMod() +   labs(x = "time", y = "cellular bile acid", title = "closed junctions: prediction band")

title: 1. Setting up models
text: TNFα activates receptor, receptor activates IKK, IKK phosphorylates IκBα NFκB complex. Phosphorylated IκBα degraded, free NFκB enters nucleus induces IκBα A20. IκBα exports NFκB, A20 inhibits IKK activation; two negative feedbacks give damped oscillations nuclear NFκB. IKK passes states Ikk, pIkk, ppIkk refractory iIkk. addReaction() adds reaction eqnlist. assignCompartment() places four nuclear species nucleus volume Vnuc relative cytoplasm. Rates concentration rates compartment educts, \[\dot x_i = \frac{1}{V_i} \sum_r S_{ri}\, V_{f(r)}\, v_r(x, p),\] \(S_{ri}\) stoichiometry \(V_{f(r)}\) volume compartment reaction \(r\). TNFα used : reaction TNF -> TNF + TNFR keeps constant catalyst. Expressions follow expression language cppDE. Factors named eta_ relate two rates, e.g. eta_form_complex_nuc nuclear cytoplasmic complex formation.
code: reactions <- eqnlist() |>   assignCompartment(nIkb = "nucleus", pnNfk = "nucleus", nNfk = "nucleus", nNfkIkb = "nucleus",                     volume = "Vnuc") |>   # receptors activated by TNFα in the medium, which they do not use up   addReaction("TNF", "TNF + TNFR", "uptake * TNF", "receptor activation") |>   addReaction("TNFR", "", "deact_TNFR * TNFR", "receptor deactivation") |>   # IKK cycle: activation by receptors, inhibited by A20, and basal; inactivation and recovery   addReaction("Ikk", "pIkk", "act_Ikk_by_TNF / (1 + A20 / inh_Ikk) * TNFR * Ikk", "IKK activation") |>   addReaction("Ikk", "pIkk", "act_Ikk_Base * Ikk", "basal IKK activation") |>   addReaction("pIkk", "ppIkk", "act_pIkk * pIkk", "IKK phosphorylation") |>   addReaction("ppIkk", "iIkk", "deact_ppIkk * ppIkk", "IKK inactivation") |>   addReaction("iIkk", "Ikk", "trigger_iIkk * iIkk", "IKK recovery") |>   # IκBα and NFκB phosphorylated in their complex, basal and by pIKK and ppIKK   addReaction("NfkIkb", "NfkpIkb", "act_Ikb_Base * NfkIkb", "basal IkBa phosphorylation") |>   addReaction("NfkIkb", "NfkpIkb", "act_Ikb_by_Ikk * pIkk * NfkIkb", "IkBa phosphorylation by pIKK") |>   addReaction("NfkIkb", "NfkpIkb", "act_Ikb_by_Ikk * eta_s_ppIkk * ppIkk * NfkIkb",               "IkBa phosphorylation by ppIKK") |>   addReaction("NfkIkb", "pNfkIkb", "act_Nfk_Base * NfkIkb", "basal NFkB phosphorylation") |>   addReaction("NfkIkb", "pNfkIkb", "act_Nfk_by_Ikk * pIkk * NfkIkb", "NFkB phosphorylation by pIKK") |>   addReaction("NfkIkb", "pNfkIkb", "act_Nfk_by_Ikk * eta_s_ppIkk * ppIkk * NfkIkb",               "NFkB phosphorylation by ppIKK") |>   addReaction("pNfkIkb", "pNfkpIkb", "act_Ikb_Base * eta_act_Ikb_Base_c_pNfkIkb * pNfkIkb",               "basal IkBa phosphorylation, pNFkB complex") |>   addReaction("pNfkIkb", "pNfkpIkb", "act_Ikb_by_Ikk * eta_act_Ikb_c_pNfkIkb * pIkk * pNfkIkb",               "IkBa phosphorylation by pIKK, pNFkB complex") |>   addReaction("pNfkIkb", "pNfkpIkb",               "act_Ikb_by_Ikk * eta_s_ppIkk * eta_act_Ikb_c_pNfkIkb * ppIkk * pNfkIkb",               "IkBa phosphorylation by ppIKK, pNFkB complex") |>   addReaction("NfkpIkb", "pNfkpIkb", "act_Nfk_Base * eta_act_Nfk_Base_c_NfkpIkb * NfkpIkb",               "basal NFkB phosphorylation, pIkBa complex") |>   addReaction("NfkpIkb", "pNfkpIkb", "act_Nfk_by_Ikk * eta_act_Nfk_c_NfkpIkb * pIkk * NfkpIkb",               "NFkB phosphorylation by pIKK, pIkBa complex") |>   addReaction("NfkpIkb", "pNfkpIkb",               "act_Nfk_by_Ikk * eta_s_ppIkk * eta_act_Nfk_c_NfkpIkb * ppIkk * NfkpIkb",               "NFkB phosphorylation by ppIKK, pIkBa complex") |>   # release of NFκB from the complex with phosphorylated IκBα, and complex formation   addReaction("NfkpIkb", "Nfk + pIkb", "split_NfkpIkb * NfkpIkb", "release of NFkB") |>   addReaction("pNfkpIkb", "pNfk + pIkb", "split_NfkIkb * eta_split_pNfkpIkb * pNfkpIkb",               "release of pNFkB") |>   addReaction("Nfk + Ikb", "NfkIkb", "form_complex * Nfk * Ikb", "complex formation") |>   # IκBα transcript, induced by nuclear NFκB, the translation, and degradation of pIκBα   addReaction("", "mIkb", "prod_mIkb_by_nNfk * nNfk", "IkBa transcription") |>   addReaction("mIkb", "", "degrad_mIkb * mIkb", "IkBa transcript degradation") |>   addReaction("", "Ikb", "prod_Ikb * mIkb", "IkBa translation") |>   addReaction("pIkb", "", "degrad_Ikb * pIkb", "pIkBa degradation") |>   # A20 transcript with two delay stages, and A20 protein   addReaction("", "RnaA20_1", "build_RnaA20 * nNfk", "A20 transcription") |>   addReaction("RnaA20_1", "RnaA20_2", "shuttle_RnaA20 * RnaA20_1", "A20 transcript, delay 1") |>   addReaction("RnaA20_2", "RnaA20", "shuttle_RnaA20 * RnaA20_2", "A20 transcript, delay 2") |>   addReaction("RnaA20", "", "degrad_RnaA20 * RnaA20", "A20 transcript degradation") |>   addReaction("", "A20", "build_A20 * RnaA20", "A20 translation") |>   addReaction("A20", "", "degrad_A20 * A20", "A20 degradation") length(reactions$states) #> [1] 23 as.eqnvec(reactions)[c("NfkIkb", "nNfk", "TNF", "TNFR")] #> Idx  Inner <- Outer #>   1 NfkIkb <- -1*(act_Ikb_Base*NfkIkb)-1*(act_Ikb_by_Ikk*pIkk*NfkIkb)-1*(act_Ikb_by_Ikk*eta_s_ppIkk*ppIkk*NfkIkb)-1*(act_Nfk_Base*NfkIkb)-1*(act_Nfk_by_Ikk*pIkk*NfkIkb)-1*(act_Nfk_by_Ikk*eta_s_ppIkk*ppIkk*NfkIkb)+1*(form_complex*Nfk*Ikb)+1*(ext_nNfkIkb*nNfkIkb)*(Vnuc/1) #>   2   nNfk <- 1*(int_Nfk*Nfk)*(1/Vnuc)+1*(deact_pnNfk*pnNfk)-1*(form_complex*eta_form_complex_nuc*nNfk*nIkb) #>   3    TNF <- 0 #>   4   TNFR <- 1*(uptake*TNF)-1*(deact_TNFR*TNFR)

text: data live-cell imaging NFκB A20-GFP, immunoblots cytoplasm, immunoblots immunoprecipitation NFκB IκBα. readout measures sum species scale s_ offset off_; imaging signals bleach rate tau_. natural log scale data, \[y = \log(s\, x + o) - \tau t .\]
code: nfkbCyt <- "NfkIkb + NfkpIkb + pNfkIkb + pNfkpIkb + pNfk + Nfk" ikbCyt <- "NfkIkb + NfkpIkb + pNfkIkb + pNfkpIkb + pIkb + Ikb" pNfkb <- "pNfkpIkb + pNfkIkb + pNfk" # log of scale times species plus offset; the imaging signals bleach exponentially, which # subtracts a term linear in time logOf <- function(stem, species, bleach = FALSE)   sprintf(if (bleach) "log(s_%1$s * (%2$s) + off_%1$s) - tau_%1$s * time"           else "log(s_%1$s * (%2$s) + off_%1$s)", stem, species)  observables <- eqnvec(   nucNFkB        = logOf("nucNFkB", "pnNfk + nNfk + nNfkIkb", bleach = TRUE),   cytNFkB        = logOf("cytNFkB", nfkbCyt, bleach = TRUE),   A20GFP         = logOf("A20GFP", "A20", bleach = TRUE),   IkBa           = logOf("IkBa", "NfkIkb + pNfkIkb + NfkpIkb + pIkb + Ikb"),   pNFkB          = logOf("pNFkB", pNfkb),   pIkBa          = logOf("pIkBa", "NfkpIkb + pNfkpIkb + pIkb"),   pIKK           = logOf("pIKK", "pIkk + ppIkk"),   ipIkBa_ibIkBa  = logOf("ipIkBa_ibIkBa", "NfkIkb + pNfkIkb + NfkpIkb + pIkb + Ikb"),   ipNFkB_ibNFkB  = logOf("ipNFkB_ibNFkB", nfkbCyt),   ipNFkB_ibpIkBa = logOf("ipNFkB_ibpIkBa", "NfkpIkb + pNfkpIkb"),   ipNFkB_ibpNFkB = logOf("ipNFkB_ibpNFkB", pNfkb),   ipIkBa_ibpNFkB = logOf("ipIkBa_ibpNFkB", "pNfkpIkb + pNfkIkb"),   ipIkBa_ibNFkB  = logOf("ipIkBa_ibNFkB", "NfkIkb + NfkpIkb + pNfkIkb + pNfkpIkb"),   ratioNFkBIkBa  = sprintf("log((%s) / (%s))", nfkbCyt, ikbCyt))

text: model.R reads CSV publication keeps HepG2 cells without compound: 312 points two conditions. .datalist() splits data condition; covariates() lists columns describe conditions.
code: # the data set of the publication, values on the natural log scale; the imaging readouts have # no standard deviation, the error model supplies one raw <- read.csv("data/oppelt2018.csv", skip = 15) readouts <- c(   "nuclear NFkB"       = "nucNFkB",   "cytoplasmic NFkB"   = "cytNFkB",   "A20"                = "A20GFP",   "IkBa"               = "IkBa",   "pIkBa"              = "pIkBa",   "pNFkB"              = "pNFkB",   "pIKK"               = "pIKK",   "IP:IkBa | IB:IkBa"  = "ipIkBa_ibIkBa",   "IP:NFkB | IB:NFkB"  = "ipNFkB_ibNFkB",   "IP:NFkB | IB:pIkBa" = "ipNFkB_ibpIkBa",   "IP:NFkB | IB:pNFkB" = "ipNFkB_ibpNFkB",   "IP:IkBa | IB:pNFkB" = "ipIkBa_ibpNFkB",   "NFkB/IkBa ratio"    = "ratioNFkBIkBa") raw$name[grepl("^IP:IkBa \\| IB:NFkB", raw$name)] <- "ipIkBa_ibNFkB" raw$name <- ifelse(raw$name %in% names(readouts), readouts[raw$name], raw$name) raw$sigma[raw$name %in% c("nucNFkB", "cytNFkB", "A20GFP")] <- NA  # HepG2 cells without a compound, on the first blot scale hepg2 <- subset(raw, cell == "HepG2" & scale == 1 & compound == "no") hepg2$condition <- ifelse(hepg2$treatment == "TNF", "TNF", "control") data <- as.datalist(hepg2[c("name", "time", "value", "sigma", "condition", "treatment")],                     splitBy = "condition", keepCovariates = "treatment") table(hepg2$name, hepg2$condition) #>                  #>                  control TNF #>   A20GFP              19  19 #>   cytNFkB             26  26 #>   IkBa                13  15 #>   ipIkBa_ibIkBa        0   9 #>   ipIkBa_ibNFkB        0   9 #>   ipIkBa_ibpNFkB       0   9 #>   ipNFkB_ibNFkB        0   9 #>   ipNFkB_ibpIkBa       0   9 #>   ipNFkB_ibpNFkB       0   9 #>   nucNFkB             26  26 #>   pIkBa               11  15 #>   pIKK                14  18 #>   pNFkB               12  17 #>   ratioNFkBIkBa        0   1 covariates(data) #>         condition treatment #> TNF           TNF       TNF #> control   control        no plotData(data, name %in% c("nucNFkB", "cytNFkB", "A20GFP", "IkBa", "pIkBa", "pIKK")) +   ggplot2::labs(x = "time [min]", y = "log signal [a.u.]")

text: define() insert() build assignments parfn p: define("x <- x", x = ...) takes every parameter pSS, x, g e except states, whose values come steady state; insert("x <- exp(x)", x = ...) puts every symbol log scale; define("TNF <- 0") sets TNFα 0 steady state; branch(covariates(data)) copies assignments per condition, define(..., conditionMatch =) sets dose. compile() builds sources one shared object getOption("dMod2.outdir") reuses object files whose source flags unchanged.
code: # every parameter on the log scale; at rest no TNFα, the dose is the unit of TNFα trafo <- eqnvec() |>   define("x <- x", x = setdiff(getParameters(pSS, x, g, e), reactions$states)) |>   insert("x <- exp(x)", x = .currentSymbols) |>   define("TNF <- 0") |>   branch(covariates(data)) |>   define("dose_TNF <- 0", conditionMatch = "control") |>   define("dose_TNF <- 1", conditionMatch = "TNF") p <- P(trafo, modelname = "oppelt_par", compile = FALSE) getEquations(p, conditions = "TNF")[c("dose_TNF", "TNF", "totalNfk", "Vnuc")] #> Idx    Inner <- Outer #>   1 dose_TNF <- 1 #>   2      TNF <- 0 #>   3 totalNfk <- exp(totalNfk) #>   4     Vnuc <- exp(Vnuc) getEquations(p, conditions = "control")[c("dose_TNF", "TNF")] #> Idx    Inner <- Outer #>   1 dose_TNF <- 0 #>   2      TNF <- 0 compile(g, x, pSS, p, e, output = "oppelt", cores = 6) prd <- g * x * pSS * p length(getParameters(prd)) #> [1] 71

title: 1. Setting up models
text: normL2(data, prd, e) returns \(-2 \log L\) gradient Gauss-Newton Hessian (Methods > Likelihood prior). constraintL2() adds Gaussian prior log scale, keeps parameters data determine finite; multistart Optimization draws starts . Mean 0 standard deviation 4, factor \(e^4 \approx 55\), parameters unknown magnitude; narrower magnitude known: Starts far outside ranges end plateaus signal bleaches away, noise explains every residual A20 follows NFκB within minutes. pSS returns unstable roots (controlsPTC = list(stability = FALSE)); constraintStability() adds term zero every perturbation resting state decays within six hours data rises 100 stability boundary. needs Pimpl(deriv2 = TRUE). Profiles stop = "data" likelihood ratios read data term without (Methods > Steady states).
code: # a weak prior on the log scale: mean 0, standard deviation 4, a factor of about 55, narrower # where the order of magnitude is known before the fit outer <- getParameters(prd) mu <- structure(rep(0, length(outer)), names = outer) sigma <- structure(rep(4, length(outer)), names = outer) # bleaching removes at most a few percent of the signal over the time of the data bleach <- grep("^tau_", outer, value = TRUE) mu[bleach] <- log(0.1 / max(as.data.frame(data)$time)) sigma[bleach] <- 2 # the imaging readouts scatter by about 5% noise <- grep("^sigma_", outer, value = TRUE) mu[noise] <- log(0.05) sigma[noise] <- 1 # without TNFα, IKK, IκBα and NFκB are activated far more slowly than after it basal <- grep("_Base$", outer, value = TRUE) mu[basal] <- -8 sigma[basal] <- 2 # transcripts and A20 are made and degraded within about an hour turnover <- c("shuttle_RnaA20", "degrad_RnaA20", "build_A20", "degrad_A20", "degrad_mIkb") mu[turnover] <- log(1 / 60) sigma[turnover] <- 2 # IKK recovers from its inactive form over hours mu["trigger_iIkk"] <- log(1 / 240) sigma["trigger_iIkk"] <- 2 # the cells rest: a term that rises where an eigenvalue of the resting state decays more slowly # than over the six hours of data and reaches 100 where the resting state loses stability stability <- constraintStability(pSS, p, duration = max(as.data.frame(data)$time)) obj <- normL2(data, prd, e) + constraintL2(mu, sigma = sigma) + stability # the stopping tolerances of trust(), above the error that the solver settings leave: ftol and # mtol an order of magnitude above that of the value (about 2e-6), gtol two above that of the # gradient (about 8e-5) tolerances <- list(ftol = 1e-4, mtol = 1e-4, gtol = 1e-2)

gradients$reverse)) / max(abs(gradients$forward)) max(abs(s$gradients$forward - s$gradients$reverse)) / max(abs(s$gradients$forward)) #> [1] 0.0002236365 # the shortest of ten evaluations, in seconds cost <- function(...) {   args <- c(list(best, fixed = gauge), list(...))   min(replicate(10, system.time(do.call(dataTerm, args))[["elapsed"]])) } timing <- c(value = cost(deriv = FALSE), forward = cost(sweep = "forward"),             reverse = cost(sweep = "reverse"),             `forward-reverse` = cost(sweep = "reverse", deriv2 = TRUE)) timing s$timing #>           value         forward         reverse forward-reverse  #>           0.004           0.167           0.011           0.724 # one evaluation of the exact Hessian forward over forward, with second-order sensitivities in all # pairs of parameters: the time and the peak memory of the process in GB peak <- function() as.numeric(gsub("\\D", "", grep("^VmHWM", readLines("/proc/self/status"), value = TRUE))) / 2^20 before <- peak() forwardForward <- system.time(ff <- dataTerm(best, fixed = gauge, sweep = "forward", deriv2 = TRUE))[["elapsed"]] memory <- c(before = before, forwardForward = peak()) c(seconds = forwardForward, memory) c(seconds = s$forwardForward, s$memory) #>        seconds         before forwardForward  #>     14.7570000      0.6036758      0.7602196 exact <- dataTerm(best, fixed = gauge, sweep = "reverse", deriv2 = TRUE)$hessian # the two exact Hessians agree up to the error of the solver max(abs(ff$hessian[rownames(exact), colnames(exact)] - Gauss-Newton keeps first, positive semidefinite term, comes free gradient; second small residuals scatter around zero. prior adds \(2/s_k^2\) diagonal. parameter-dependent error model matrix \(J^\top L J\), necessarily semidefinite (Sensitivities Hessians). large residuals Gauss-Newton model can stop short minimum.

title: Trust-region optimization
text: quasi-Newton updates use secant pair \[s_k = \theta_{k+1} - \theta_k, \qquad y_k = \nabla f(\theta_{k+1}) - \nabla f(\theta_k), \tag{8}\] secant equation \(B_{k+1} s_k = y_k\). BFGS keeps \(B\) positive definite, needs \(s^\top y > 0\); pair damped [6]: \[\vartheta = \begin{cases} 1, & s^\top y \ge 0.2\, s^\top B s, \\ \dfrac{0.8\, s^\top B s}{s^\top B s - s^\top y}, & \text{otherwise,} \end{cases} \qquad \tilde y = \vartheta y + (1 - \vartheta) B s , \tag{9}\] update \[B_{k+1} = B_k - \frac{B_k s\, s^\top B_k}{s^\top B_k s} + \frac{\tilde y\, \tilde y^\top}{s^\top \tilde y}. \tag{10}\] \(s^\top \tilde y \ge 0.2\, s^\top B s > 0\). qnCautious [7] skips pairs \(s^\top y \le c \lVert s \rVert \lVert y \rVert\) (counted qnSkipped). BFGS updates accepted steps .

title: Trust-region optimization
text: SR1 satisfies secant equation without definiteness. \(w = y - B_k s\), \[B_{k+1} = B_k + \frac{w\, w^\top}{w^\top s}, \tag{11}\] skipped \(\lvert w^\top s \rvert \le 10^{-8} \lVert s \rVert \lVert w \rVert\). SR1 approaches true Hessian, indefinite regions included. Rejected trial points also give valid pairs [5]; qnRejected (default "sr1") uses .

title: Trust-region optimization
text: Far optimum \(J^\top J\) large ill-conditioned; BFGS corrects seed wrong orders magnitude slowly, SR1 overwrites . qnMemory \(= m > 0\) approximation rebuilt \(\gamma \), \(\gamma = y^\top y / s^\top y\) [8], last \(m\) pairs, curvature L-BFGS [5] explicit matrix. diagonal preconditioner: log scale ill-conditioning sloppy models lies along rotated directions [9].

title: Trust-region optimization
text: trustL1() minimizes objective plus L1 penalty parameters [11], \[f(\theta) + \sum_{\P} \lambda_i \lvert \theta_i - \mu_i \rvert , \tag{12}\] penalized parameters \(P\), references \(\mu_i\) strengths \(\lambda_i\). trustL1() runs trust region Gauss-Newton Hessian two changes: parameter kink removed (1) \(\lvert \partial f / \partial \theta_i \rvert \le \lambda_i\), step across kink cut back onto \(\mu_i\), zero differences exact. one-sided penalty \[\lambda_i \max(0,\, \mu_i - \theta_i) . \tag{13}\] gate \(\lambda_i (\theta_i - \mu_i)\) \(\theta_i \ge \mu_i\), fused block \(B\) \[\lambda \sum_{p < q \B} w_{pq}\, \lvert \theta_p - \theta_q \rvert , \tag{14}\] optionally anchor; equal parameters move one data split .

code: library(dMod2) dir.create("build", showWarnings = FALSE) # generated sources and shared objects in build/, reused when nothing changed options(dMod2.outdir = "build") cores <- max(1L, min(20L, parallel::detectCores() - 2L)) nstart <- 100L # second derivatives forward over reverse for FOCEI, forward over forward for the reported Hessian dm <- c("forward", "reverse", "forward-reverse")  # fits are saved in results/cache.rds under a key and read from there when present; delete the # file to fit everything again cached <- function(key, expr) {   file <- "results/cache.rds"   dir.create("results", showWarnings = FALSE)   store <- if (file.exists(file)) readRDS(file) else list()   if (is.null(store[[key]])) {     store[[key]] <- expr     saveRDS(store, file)   }   store[[key]] } # a fit of em() cached without the model, which an evaluation at the fit estimates restores cachedEm <- function(key, obj, random, start, control = list(), ...) {   model <- c("design", "prdfn", "errfn", "data")   f <- cached(key, { f <- em(obj, random, start, control = control, ...); f[model] <- NULL; f })   f[model] <- em(obj, random, f, control = modifyList(control, list(trustControl = list(iterlim = 0),                                                                     boundary = FALSE)),                  verbose = FALSE)[model]   f }

code: drawStarts <- function(init, n = nstart) {   set.seed(1)   rbind(init, t(vapply(seq_len(n - 1L), function(i) init + rnorm(length(init), 0, 0.5), init))) }  # dMod2 from every start; the fits as a table of -2 log L, convergence, seconds and estimates runDMod2 <- function(obj, random, starts, method) {   out <- parallel::mclapply(seq_len(nrow(starts)), function(i) {     options(dMod2.cores = 1L)     set.seed(i)     t <- system.time(f <- tryCatch(em(obj, random, starts[i, ], method = method, verbose = FALSE),                                    error = function(e) NULL))[["elapsed"]]     if (is.null(f)) return(list(value = NA_real_, converged = FALSE, seconds = t, argument = NULL))     list(value = f$value, converged = isTRUE(f$converged), seconds = t, argument = f$argument)   }, mc.cores = cores, mc.preschedule = FALSE)   data.frame(package = "dMod2", start = seq_along(out), value = vapply(out, `[[`, 0, "value"),              converged = vapply(out, `[[`, TRUE, "converged"), seconds = vapply(out, `[[`, 0, "seconds")) }  # per method the best value, the starts within 0.1 of it, the failed and unconverged fits, the # median and total seconds per fit; `runs` a named list of the tables of runDMod2() summarizeStarts <- function(runs) {   do.call(rbind, lapply(names(runs), function(m) {     r <- runs[[m]]     best <- min(r$value, na.rm = TRUE)     data.frame(method = m, best = best, hits = sum(r$value - best < 0.1, na.rm = TRUE),                failed = sum(is.na(r$value)), unconverged = sum(!r$converged & !is.na(r$value)),                medianSeconds = stats::median(r$seconds), totalSeconds = sum(r$seconds))   })) }  # the waterfall of every method, a panel each, and the seconds per fit plotStarts <- function(runs, title) {   w <- plotValues(runs, pseudoLog = TRUE) + ggplot2::labs(title = title)   seconds <- do.call(rbind, lapply(names(runs), function(m) data.frame(method = m, seconds = runs[[m]]$seconds)))   s <- ggplot2::ggplot(seconds, ggplot2::aes(method, seconds)) + ggplot2::geom_boxplot() +     ggplot2::scale_y_log10(labels = scales::label_log()) +     ggplot2::labs(x = NULL, y = "seconds per fit, one core") + theme_dMod()   cowplot::plot_grid(w, s, nrow = 1, rel_widths = c(2, 1)) }  # -2 log L of FOCEI at given estimates, the definition under which the SAEM fits are compared focei <- function(obj, random, pars)   em(obj, random, pars, control = list(trustControl = list(iterlim = 0)), verbose = FALSE)$value  # the multistarts of FOCEI and SAEM of one model, and the best SAEM fit with -2 log L of FOCEI at # the SAEM estimates; `saem` the model SAEM fits compareMethods <- function(runs, label, saem) {   runs <- list(FOCEI = runs$focei, SAEM = runs$saem)   print(summarizeStarts(runs))   print(plotStarts(runs, label))   sfit <- cachedEm(paste(label, "dMod2 saem best"), saem$obj, saem$random, saem$starts[which.min(runs$SAEM$value), ],                    method = "saem", verbose = FALSE)   print(round(sfit$argument, 4))   print(c(SAEM = focei(saem$obj, saem$random, sfit$argument)))   invisible(NULL) }

title: Theophylline, warfarin and mavoglurant
text: 120 subjects, infusion 10 min (20 min one occasion) time switch, 78 subjects two occasions. Two compartments; clearances scale weight power 0.75, volumes weight. Clearance, central peripheral volume intercompartmental clearance vary subjects, clearance also occasions subject, (1 | ID:OCC). SAEM fits model without variability occasions.
code: data(mavoglurant) mavoData <- as.datalist(mavoglurant, splitBy = "condition",                         keepCovariates = c("ID", "OCC", "dose", "duration", "AGE", "SEX", "WT", "HT")) mavoNet <- eqnlist() |>   assignCompartment(C1 = "central", volume = "V1") |>   assignCompartment(C2 = "peripheral", volume = "V2") |>   setCompartmentVolume(unit = "1") |>   addReaction("", "C1", "piecewise(dose / duration, time < duration, 0)", "infusion", rateCompartment = "unit") |>   addReaction("C1", "", "CL * C1", "elimination", rateCompartment = "unit") |>   addReaction("C1", "C2", "Q * C1", "distribution", rateCompartment = "unit") |>   addReaction("C2", "C1", "Q * C2", "redistribution", rateCompartment = "unit") mavoNet #>  #> Compartments: #>   central (V=V1) #>   peripheral (V=V2) #>   unit (V=1) #> States by compartment: #>   central: C1 #>   peripheral: C2 #>  #>   Check Educt -> Product                                           Rate #> 1             ->      C1 piecewise(dose / duration, time < duration, 0) #> 2          C1 ->                                                CL * C1 #> 3          C1 ->      C2                                         Q * C1 #> 4          C2 ->      C1                                         Q * C2 #>      Description #> 1       infusion #> 2    elimination #> 3   distribution #> 4 redistribution # solver tolerances 1e-10: at the defaults the solver error, absolute in mg/L, moves -2 log L by # about 1e-3, more than the fit resolves mavoX <- Xs(odemodel(mavoNet, modelname = "pm_mavo", compile = FALSE, deriv2 = TRUE, derivMode = dm),             options = list(atol = 1e-10, rtol = 1e-10)) # the dose in mg, the concentration in ng/mL mavoG <- Y(c(cp = "1000 * C1"), mavoX, modelname = "pm_mavo_g", compile = FALSE, deriv2 = TRUE, derivMode = dm) mavoE <- Y(c(cp = "sqrt(sigma_abs^2 + (sigma_rel * cp)^2)"), mavoG, attachInput = FALSE, modelname = "pm_mavo_e",            compile = FALSE, deriv2 = TRUE, derivMode = dm) mavoTable <- attr(mavoData, "condition.grid") mavoTable$ID <- as.character(mavoTable$ID) mavoTrafo <- function(between) {   tr <- branch(define(NULL, "x <- x", x = c("CL", "V1", "Q", "V2", "C1", "C2", "dose", "duration", "sigma_abs",                                                 "sigma_rel")),                table = mavoTable)   tr <- insert(tr, "dose <- d", d = dose)   tr <- insert(tr, "duration <- u", u = duration)   tr <- insert(tr, "x <- 0", x = c("C1", "C2"))   tr <- insert(tr, "x <- x * (w / 70)^0.75", x = c("CL", "Q"), w = WT)   tr <- insert(tr, "x <- x * w / 70", x = c("V1", "V2"), w = WT)   tr <- insert(tr, "x <- exp(x)", x = c("CL", "V1", "Q", "V2", "sigma_abs", "sigma_rel"))   if (between) tr <- insert(tr, CL ~ 1 + (1 | ID) + (1 | ID:OCC)) else tr <- insert(tr, CL ~ 1 + (1 | ID))   insert(tr, V1 + Q + V2 ~ 1 + (1 | ID)) } mavoP <- P(mavoTrafo(TRUE), method = "explicit", modelname = "pm_mavo_p", compile = FALSE, deriv2 = TRUE,            derivMode = dm) mavoP1 <- P(mavoTrafo(FALSE), method = "explicit", modelname = "pm_mavo_p1", compile = FALSE, deriv2 = TRUE,             derivMode = dm) compileSeconds["mavoglurant"] <- system.time(compile(mavoX, mavoG, mavoE, mavoP, mavoP1,                                                      output = "pm_mavo_all"))[["elapsed"]] mavoObj <- normL2(mavoData, mavoG * mavoX * mavoP, errmodel = mavoE) mavoObj1 <- normL2(mavoData, mavoG * mavoX * mavoP1, errmodel = mavoE) mavoRandom <- randomEffects(mavoP) mavoRandom1 <- randomEffects(mavoP1) mavoRandom #> Random effects: 5 terms over ID, ID:OCC #>   block 1 (normal, ID): eta_CL #>   block 2 (normal, ID:OCC): eta_CL_ID_OCC #>   block 3 (normal, ID): eta_V1 #>   block 4 (normal, ID): eta_Q #>   block 5 (normal, ID): eta_V2 #>   fixed effects: CL, V1, Q, V2 mavoInit <- c(CL = log(30), V1 = log(40), Q = log(30), V2 = log(150), sigma_abs = log(1), sigma_rel = log(0.2),               omega_CL_CL = log(0.3),               omega_V1_V1 = log(0.3), omega_Q_Q = log(0.3), omega_V2_V2 = log(0.3)) mavoStarts <- drawStarts(c(mavoInit, omega_CL_ID_OCC_CL_ID_OCC = log(0.15))) mavoStarts1 <- mavoStarts[, names(mavoInit)] mavoRuns <- cached("Mavoglurant dMod2", list(focei = runDMod2(mavoObj, mavoRandom, mavoStarts, "focei"),                                               saem = runDMod2(mavoObj1, mavoRandom1, mavoStarts1, "saem"))) mavoFit <- cachedEm("Mavoglurant dMod2 focei best", mavoObj, mavoRandom,                     mavoStarts[which.min(mavoRuns$focei$value), ], verbose = FALSE) summary(mavoFit) #> EM summary (focei): -2 log L code: ## Five time points on six gels, each gel with a separate scale and an additive background set.seed(1) d <- expand.grid(time = c("0", "10", "30", "60", "120"), gel = paste0("G", 1:6),                  stringsAsFactors = FALSE) truth <- c(0.02, 1, 4, 2, 0.5)[match(d$time, c("0", "10", "30", "60", "120"))] d$value <- (rlnorm(6, 7, 0.5)[match(d$gel, unique(d$gel))] * truth + 50) * rlnorm(nrow(d), 0, 0.1)  # \donttest{ old <- options(dMod2.outdir = tempdir()) ## every symbol positive, on the log scale of the predictor; one value per time point, ## one scale per gel logs <- c("yi <- exp(yi)", "sj <- exp(sj)", "bj <- exp(bj)", "sigmaR <- exp(sigmaR)") m <- alignmentModel(d, model = "yi * sj + bj", errmodel = "sigmaR * prediction",                     biological = yi ~ time, scaling = sj ~ gel, error = bj + sigmaR ~ 1,                     trafo = logs) #> using C++ compiler: g++ [-O2 -DNDEBUG -w -fPIC -fopenmp] ## a background varying between gels: a list of formulas for one role m2 <- alignmentModel(d, model = "yi * sj + bj", errmodel = "sigmaR * prediction",                      biological = yi ~ time, scaling = list(sj ~ gel, bj ~ 1 + (1 | gel)),                      error = sigmaR ~ 1, trafo = logs) m #> alignmentModel: 30 readings, model yi * sj + bj, error sigmaR * prediction #>   yi         biological    5 parameters, yi = exp(yi) #>   sj         scaling       6 parameters, sj = exp(sj) #>   bj         error         1 parameter, bj = exp(bj) #>   sigmaR     error         1 parameter, sigmaR = exp(sigmaR) #>   mean of yi normalized in 1 block of experiments m2 #> alignmentModel: 30 readings, model yi * sj + bj, error sigmaR * prediction #>   yi         biological    5 parameters, yi = exp(yi) #>   sj         scaling       6 parameters, sj = exp(sj) #>   bj         scaling       1 parameter, bj = exp(bj), random over gel #>   sigmaR     error         1 parameter, sigmaR = exp(sigmaR) #>   mean of yi normalized in 1 block of experiments fit <- align(m, fits = 4) fit #> alignment: 30 readings, 5 biological values, 12 parameters #>   restricted likelihood (REML, 2 rounds): -2 log L 389.06, AIC 413.06 #>   maximum likelihood fits, REML from the best: -2 log L 329.79 329.79 329.79 329.79 fit$aligned #>   time symbol   estimate         se      value       sigma #> 1    0     yi -3.2127997 0.18302237 0.04024378 0.007365512 #> 2   10     yi  0.4499769 0.05497631 1.56827596 0.086218023 #> 3   30     yi  1.7783403 0.05924187 5.92002292 0.350713229 #> 4   60     yi  1.1659908 0.05670480 3.20910085 0.181971415 #> 5  120     yi -0.1815083 0.05135481 0.83401135 0.042830490 plotAligned(fit)  options(old) # }

title: Compare nested mixed-effects fits — anova.em
code: # \donttest{ ## Theophylline, 12 subjects: one-compartment model with first-order absorption in closed ## form, log parameters with a normal random intercept per subject, additive error th <- datasets::Theoph th$Subject <- as.character(th$Subject) subjects <- unique(th$Subject) data <- as.datalist(data.frame(name = "y", time = th$Time, value = th$conc, sigma = NA_real_,                                condition = th$Subject)) ## second derivatives forward over reverse, the default of em() dm <- c("forward", "reverse", "forward-reverse") x <- Xt() g <- Y(c(y = "amt * Ka / (V * Ka - Cl) * (exp(-Cl / V * time) - exp(-Ka * time))"),        states = "time", modelname = "theoph_obs", compile = FALSE, derivMode = dm,        outdir = tempdir()) err <- Y(c(y = "sigma_add"), g, attachInput = FALSE, modelname = "theoph_err", compile = FALSE,          derivMode = dm, outdir = tempdir()) ## one condition per subject with the subject dose; the effect formula replaces each log parameter ## by an intercept plus a random effect per subject doses <- tapply(th$Dose * th$Wt, th$Subject, `[`, 1)[subjects] trafo <- branch(define(NULL, "x <- x", x = c("Ka", "V", "Cl", "amt", "sigma_add")),                 table = data.frame(ID = subjects, dose = doses, row.names = subjects)) trafo <- insert(trafo, "amt <- dose", dose = dose) trafo <- insert(trafo, "x <- exp(x)", x = c("Ka", "V", "Cl", "sigma_add")) p <- P(insert(trafo, Ka + V + Cl ~ 1 + (1 | ID)), method = "explicit", compile = FALSE,        modelname = "theoph_p", derivMode = dm, outdir = tempdir()) compile(g, err, p, output = tempfile("theoph")) #> using C++ compiler: g++ [-O2 -DNDEBUG -w -fPIC] obj <- normL2(data, g * x * p, errmodel = err) fit <- em(obj, randomEffects(p), init = c(Ka = 0, V = 3, Cl = 0.7, sigma_add = log(0.5)))  ## the nested model without a random effect on V p0 <- P(insert(trafo, Ka + Cl ~ 1 + (1 | ID)), method = "explicit", compile = FALSE,         modelname = "theoph_p0", derivMode = dm, outdir = tempdir()) compile(p0, output = tempfile("theoph")) #> using C++ compiler: g++ [-O2 -DNDEBUG -w -fPIC] fit0 <- em(normL2(data, g * x * p0, errmodel = err), randomEffects(p0),            init = c(Ka = 0, V = 3, Cl = 0.7, sigma_add = log(0.5))) anova(fit0, fit) #>   model npar    value      AIC      BIC   chisq df            p #> 1     1    6 372.8893 384.8893 402.1861      NA NA           NA #> 2     2    7 359.4032 373.4032 393.5828 13.4861  1 0.0002403376 # }

code: ## Equation list eq <- eqnlist() eq <- addReaction(eq, "A", "pA", "act_A * A * stimulus", "Phosphorylation of A") eq <- addReaction(eq, "pA", "A", "deact_A * pA", "Dephosphorylation of pA") eq <- addReaction(eq, "2*pA", "pA_pA", "form_complex_pA * pA^2", "Complex formation of pA") eq <- addReaction(eq, "B", "pB", "act_B * B * pA_pA", "Phosphorylation of B") eq <- addReaction(eq, "pB", "B", "deact_B * pB", "Dephosphorylation of pB")  ## Data frame of reactions reactions <- getReactions(eq) print(reactions) #>   Check Educt -> Product                   Rate             Description #> 1           A ->      pA   act_A * A * stimulus    Phosphorylation of A #> 2          pA ->       A           deact_A * pA Dephosphorylation of pA #> 3        2*pA ->   pA_pA form_complex_pA * pA^2 Complex formation of pA #> 4           B ->      pB      act_B * B * pA_pA    Phosphorylation of B #> 5          pB ->       B           deact_B * pB Dephosphorylation of pB  ## Conserved quantities print(conservedQuantities(eq)) #> $total_1 #> [1] "0.5*A+0.5*pA+1*pA_pA" #>  #> $total_2 #> [1] "1*B+1*pB" #>   ## Fluxes fluxes <- getFluxes(eq) print(fluxes) #> $A #>        Phosphorylation of A     Dephosphorylation of pA  #> "-1*(act_A * A * stimulus)"         "+1*(deact_A * pA)"  #>  #> $pA #>          Phosphorylation of A       Dephosphorylation of pA  #>    "1*(act_A * A * stimulus)"           "-1*(deact_A * pA)"  #>       Complex formation of pA  #> "-2*(form_complex_pA * pA^2)"  #>  #> $pA_pA #>      Complex formation of pA  #> "1*(form_complex_pA * pA^2)"  #>  #> $B #>     Phosphorylation of B  Dephosphorylation of pB  #> "-1*(act_B * B * pA_pA)"      "+1*(deact_B * pB)"  #>  #> $pB #>    Phosphorylation of B Dephosphorylation of pB  #> "1*(act_B * B * pA_pA)"     "-1*(deact_B * pB)"  #>   ## Subsetting subeq1 <- subset(eq, "pB" %in% Product) print(subeq1) #> Conserved quantities: #>   pA_pA = 1*pA_pA #>   total_2 = 1*B+1*pB #>  #>   Check Educt -> Product              Rate          Description #> 1           B ->      pB act_B * B * pA_pA Phosphorylation of B subeq2 <- subset(eq, grepl("not_available", Description)) print(subeq2) #>  #> NULL  ## Equation vector of the ODE f <- as.eqnvec(eq) print(f) #> Idx Inner <- Outer #>   1     A <- -1*(act_A*A*stimulus)+1*(deact_A*pA) #>   2     B <- -1*(act_B*B*pA_pA)+1*(deact_B*pB) #>   3    pA <- 1*(act_A*A*stimulus)-1*(deact_A*pA)-2*(form_complex_pA*pA^2) #>   4 pA_pA <- 1*(form_complex_pA*pA^2) #>   5    pB <- 1*(act_B*B*pA_pA)-1*(deact_B*pB)

title: Construct and Modify Parameter Transformations — define
code: ## Identity for four parameters, then log parameters trafo <- define(NULL, "x <- x", x = c("A", "B", "k1", "k2")) trafo <- insert(trafo, "x <- exp(x)", x = .currentSymbols) trafo #> Idx Inner <- Outer #>   1     A <- exp(A) #>   2     B <- exp(B) #>   3    k1 <- exp(k1) #>   4    k2 <- exp(k2)  ## Replace k1 and k2 by expressions, fix B trafo <- insert(trafo, "x <- y", x = c("k1", "k2"), y = c("q1 + q2", "q1 - q2")) trafo <- define(trafo, "B <- 0") trafo #> Idx Inner <- Outer #>   1     A <- exp(A) #>   2     B <- 0 #>   3    k1 <- exp(q1+q2) #>   4    k2 <- exp(q1-q2)  ## One branch per condition; the non-missing table entries are inserted conditions <- data.frame(dose = c(1, 10), q2 = c(NA, "q2_high"),                          row.names = c("low", "high")) trafoL <- branch(trafo, table = conditions, apply = "insert")  ## Condition-specific changes, selected by name or read off the table trafoL <- insert(trafoL, "x <- 2*x", x = "q1", conditionMatch = "^high") trafoL <- define(trafoL, "A <- dose", dose = dose) trafoL #> $low #> Idx Inner <- Outer #>   1     A <- 1 #>   2     B <- 0 #>   3    k1 <- exp(q1+q2) #>   4    k2 <- exp(q1-q2) #>  #> $high #> Idx Inner <- Outer #>   1     A <- 10 #>   2     B <- 0 #>   3    k1 <- exp((2*q1)+q2_high) #>   4    k2 <- exp((2*q1)-q2_high) #>  #> attr(,"tree") #>      dose      q2 #> low     1    <NA> #> high   10 q2_high

code: # \donttest{ # Two tasks on the local machine, in a temporary working directory; each task # starts an R process if (.Platform$OS.type == "unix") {   old <- setwd(tempdir())   M <- matrix(rnorm(1e2), 10, 10)   job <- distributedComputing(det(M * task), tasks = list(a = 1, b = 2),                               input = "M", jobname = "example")   job$wait(interval = 0.1)   print(job$get())   job$purge(local = TRUE)   setwd(old) } #> example: 2 tasks started on localhost (3 cores) #> example: 0 of 2 tasks done, 2 running #> example: 1 of 2 tasks done, 1 running #> example: 2 of 2 tasks done #> $a #> [1] -403.4075 #>  #> $b #> [1] -413089.3 #>  # }  if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{ # For an objective obj and a center of the starts: multistarts on two nodes # reached by ssh, one task per node with ten fits per core nodes <- sshNodes(c("server1", "server2"), cores = 16) jobFitting <- distributedComputing(   mstrust(obj, center, fits = 10 * cores, cores = cores, sd = 4),   on = nodes, jobname = "fits" ) jobFitting$wait() bestfit <- as.parvec(jobFitting$get()) jobFitting$purge(local = TRUE)  # Profiles of the best fit: one task per group of four parameters and side, on # the free cores of both nodes. get() joins the sides of every parameter. groups <- split(names(bestfit), ceiling(seq_along(bestfit) / 4)) jobProfiling <- distributedComputing(   profile(obj, bestfit, whichPar = groups[[task$group]], side = task$side,           limits = c(-5, 5), cores = cores),   tasks = expand.grid(group = seq_along(groups), side = c("left", "right"),                       stringsAsFactors = FALSE),   on = sshNodes(c("server1", "server2")), jobname = "profiles" ) jobProfiling$wait() profiles <- jobProfiling$get() confint(profiles)  # 1000 fits on a SLURM cluster: 100 array tasks of 10 fits on 10 cores each, # through the job script template of the login node "mycluster", set up once # from a job script of the cluster with the placeholders of ?slurmTemplate. slurmTemplate("mycluster", from = "~/mycluster.sh") cluster <- slurmCluster("mycluster", cores = 10, walltime = "02:00:00") job <- distributedComputing(   mstrust(obj, center, fits = cores, cores = cores, sd = 4),   tasks = 100, on = cluster, jobname = "slurmfits" )  # The ten starts of one mixed-effects multistart as ten array tasks of four cores: # every task draws the same starts and fits a separate part, get() joins them into one fit jobEm <- distributedComputing({   set.seed(1)   msem(obj, random, init, fits = 10, which = taskId,        cores = c(fits = 1, conditions = cores)) }, tasks = 10, on = slurmCluster("mycluster", cores = 4, walltime = "06:00:00"), jobname = "msemfits")  # The jobs submitted and not purged, and the functions of one of them dMod2Jobs() job <- distributedComputing(NULL, jobname = "slurmfits", recover = TRUE) } # }

code: # \donttest{ ## Theophylline, 12 subjects: one-compartment model with first-order absorption in closed ## form, log parameters with a normal random intercept per subject, additive error th <- datasets::Theoph th$Subject <- as.character(th$Subject) subjects <- unique(th$Subject) data <- as.datalist(data.frame(name = "y", time = th$Time, value = th$conc, sigma = NA_real_,                                condition = th$Subject)) ## second derivatives forward over reverse, the default of em() dm <- c("forward", "reverse", "forward-reverse") x <- Xt() g <- Y(c(y = "amt * Ka / (V * Ka - Cl) * (exp(-Cl / V * time) - exp(-Ka * time))"),        states = "time", modelname = "theoph_obs", compile = FALSE, derivMode = dm,        outdir = tempdir()) #> Overwriting: /tmp/Rtmp8qFUqD/theoph_obs.cpp err <- Y(c(y = "sigma_add"), g, attachInput = FALSE, modelname = "theoph_err", compile = FALSE,          derivMode = dm, outdir = tempdir()) #> Overwriting: /tmp/Rtmp8qFUqD/theoph_err.cpp ## one condition per subject with the subject dose; the effect formula replaces each log parameter ## by an intercept plus a random effect per subject doses <- tapply(th$Dose * th$Wt, th$Subject, `[`, 1)[subjects] trafo <- branch(define(NULL, "x <- x", x = c("Ka", "V", "Cl", "amt", "sigma_add")),                 table = data.frame(ID = subjects, dose = doses, row.names = subjects)) trafo <- insert(trafo, "amt <- dose", dose = dose) trafo <- insert(trafo, "x <- exp(x)", x = c("Ka", "V", "Cl", "sigma_add")) p <- P(insert(trafo, Ka + V + Cl ~ 1 + (1 | ID)), method = "explicit", compile = FALSE,        modelname = "theoph_p", derivMode = dm, outdir = tempdir()) compile(g, err, p, output = tempfile("theoph")) #> using C++ compiler: g++ [-O2 -DNDEBUG -w -fPIC] #> reusing 14 unchanged object(s) obj <- normL2(data, g * x * p, errmodel = err) init <- c(Ka = 0, V = 3, Cl = 0.7, sigma_add = log(0.5))  ## FOCEI fit, the estimates and the random effects per subject fit <- em(obj, randomEffects(p), init = init) fit #> EM (focei): -2 log L 359.403186, converged TRUE, 10 iterations, 12 groups #>          Ka           V          Cl   sigma_add omega_Ka_Ka   omega_V_V  #>   0.4638825   3.4597479   1.0121568  -0.3647014  -0.4552240  -1.9774269  #> omega_Cl_Cl  #>  -1.3361153  #> Random effects: #>  type eta1 eta2  estimate         se #>    sd   Ka   Ka 0.6343058 0.14972302 #>    sd    V    V 0.1384250 0.04075699 #>    sd   Cl   Cl 0.2628648 0.06586477 summary(fit) #> EM summary (focei): -2 log L 359.403186, converged TRUE, 10 iterations #>   without the 2 pi constant of the data (NONMEM OBJ): 116.803413 #>  #> Parameters: #>             estimate      se rsePct #> Ka            0.4639 0.19180 41.350 #> V             3.4600 0.04718  1.364 #> Cl            1.0120 0.08333  8.233 #> sigma_add    -0.3647 0.07268 19.930 #> omega_Ka_Ka  -0.4552 0.23600 51.850 #> omega_V_V    -1.9770 0.29440 14.890 #> omega_Cl_Cl  -1.3360 0.25060 18.750 #> Standard errors without the curvature of the prediction in the random effects within the volume term (forward over reverse; deriv2 = TRUE gives the full one) #>  #> Random effects: #>  type eta1 eta2 estimate      se #>    sd   Ka   Ka   0.6343 0.14970 #>    sd    V    V   0.1384 0.04076 #>    sd   Cl   Cl   0.2629 0.06586 #>  #> Shrinkage: eta_Ka = 0.018, eta_V = 0.103, eta_Cl = 0.039  fit$omega #>   type eta1 eta2  estimate         se #> 1   sd   Ka   Ka 0.6343058 0.14972302 #> 2   sd    V    V 0.1384250 0.04075699 #> 3   sd   Cl   Cl 0.2628648 0.06586477 head(fit$random) #>   group eta parameter        mode        se #> 1     1  Ka  eta_Ka_1  0.08621976 0.1515854 #> 2     2  Ka  eta_Ka_2  0.19818408 0.1725709 #> 3     3  Ka  eta_Ka_3  0.37186008 0.1810720 #> 4     4  Ka  eta_Ka_4 -0.28173371 0.1640986 #> 5     5  Ka  eta_Ka_5 -0.04271272 0.1461175 #> 6     6  Ka  eta_Ka_6 -0.38568935 0.2043190  ## quadrature started from the FOCEI estimates, and SAEM fitQ <- em(obj, randomEffects(p), init = fit, method = "quadrature", verbose = FALSE) fitS <- em(obj, randomEffects(p), init = init, method = "saem", verbose = FALSE) c(focei = fit$value, quadrature = fitQ$value, saem = fitS$value) #>      focei quadrature       saem  #>   359.4032   360.7548   360.7588  # } if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{ ## Ka and Cl with correlated random effects, V with a Laplace one: a second transformation p2 <- P(insert(trafo, Ka + Cl ~ 1 + (1 | p | ID), V ~ 1 + (1 | gr(ID, dist = laplace()))),         method = "explicit", compile = FALSE, modelname = "theoph_p2", derivMode = dm,         outdir = tempdir()) compile(p2, output = tempfile("theoph")) fit2 <- em(normL2(data, g * x * p2, errmodel = err), randomEffects(p2), init = init) fit2$omega fit2$strengths AIC(fit, fit2) } # }

code: # \donttest{ ## Theophylline, 12 subjects: one-compartment model with first-order absorption in closed ## form, log parameters with a normal random intercept per subject, additive error th <- datasets::Theoph th$Subject <- as.character(th$Subject) subjects <- unique(th$Subject) data <- as.datalist(data.frame(name = "y", time = th$Time, value = th$conc, sigma = NA_real_,                                condition = th$Subject)) ## second derivatives forward over reverse, the default of em() dm <- c("forward", "reverse", "forward-reverse") x <- Xt() g <- Y(c(y = "amt * Ka / (V * Ka - Cl) * (exp(-Cl / V * time) - exp(-Ka * time))"),        states = "time", modelname = "theoph_obs", compile = FALSE, derivMode = dm,        outdir = tempdir()) #> Overwriting: /tmp/Rtmp8qFUqD/theoph_obs.cpp err <- Y(c(y = "sigma_add"), g, attachInput = FALSE, modelname = "theoph_err", compile = FALSE,          derivMode = dm, outdir = tempdir()) #> Overwriting: /tmp/Rtmp8qFUqD/theoph_err.cpp ## one condition per subject with the subject dose; the effect formula replaces each log parameter ## by an intercept plus a random effect per subject doses <- tapply(th$Dose * th$Wt, th$Subject, `[`, 1)[subjects] trafo <- branch(define(NULL, "x <- x", x = c("Ka", "V", "Cl", "amt", "sigma_add")),                 table = data.frame(ID = subjects, dose = doses, row.names = subjects)) trafo <- insert(trafo, "amt <- dose", dose = dose) trafo <- insert(trafo, "x <- exp(x)", x = c("Ka", "V", "Cl", "sigma_add")) p <- P(insert(trafo, Ka + V + Cl ~ 1 + (1 | ID)), method = "explicit", compile = FALSE,        modelname = "theoph_p", derivMode = dm, outdir = tempdir()) compile(g, err, p, output = tempfile("theoph")) #> using C++ compiler: g++ [-O2 -DNDEBUG -w -fPIC] #> reusing 14 unchanged object(s) obj <- normL2(data, g * x * p, errmodel = err) fit <- em(obj, randomEffects(p), init = c(Ka = 0, V = 3, Cl = 0.7, sigma_add = log(0.5)))  ## estimates and their standard errors coef(fit) #>          Ka           V          Cl   sigma_add omega_Ka_Ka   omega_V_V  #>   0.4638825   3.4597479   1.0121568  -0.3647014  -0.4552240  -1.9774269  #> omega_Cl_Cl  #>  -1.3361153  sqrt(diag(vcov(fit))) #>          Ka           V          Cl   sigma_add omega_Ka_Ka   omega_V_V  #>  0.19181010  0.04717589  0.08333122  0.07267625  0.23604232  0.29443384  #> omega_Cl_Cl  #>  0.25056516   ## the effect formula replaces each log parameter ## by an intercept plus a random effect per subject doses <- tapply(th$Dose * th$Wt, th$Subject, `[`, 1)[subjects] trafo <- branch(define(NULL, "x <- x", x = c("Ka", "V", "Cl", "amt", "sigma_add")),                 table = data.frame(ID = subjects, dose = doses, row.names = subjects)) trafo <- insert(trafo, "amt <- dose", dose = dose) trafo <- insert(trafo, "x <- exp(x)", x = c("Ka", "V", "Cl", "sigma_add")) p <- P(insert(trafo, Ka + V + Cl ~ 1 + (1 | ID)), method = "explicit", compile = FALSE,        modelname = "theoph_p", derivMode = dm, outdir = tempdir()) compile(g, err, p, output = tempfile("theoph")) #> using C++ compiler: g++ [-O2 -DNDEBUG -w -fPIC] #> reusing 14 unchanged object(s) obj <- normL2(data, g * x * p, errmodel = err) init <- c(Ka = 0, V = 3, Cl = 0.7, sigma_add = log(0.5))  ## four starts: the first at init, the others perturbed best <- msem(obj, randomEffects(p), init = init, fits = 4) best$multistart #>   start    value converged iterations    gradient tries stop failures error #> 1     1 359.4032      TRUE         10 0.002975526     1 <NA>           <NA> #> 2     2 359.4032      TRUE         11 0.002859698     1 <NA>           <NA> #> 3     3 359.4032      TRUE         14 0.000496391     1 <NA>           <NA> #> 4     4 359.4032      TRUE         11 0.001513915     1 <NA>           <NA> #>   boundary #> 1          #> 2          #> 3          #> 4          plotValues(best)  # } if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{ ## 20 starts, four fits at a time best <- msem(obj, randomEffects(p), init = init, fits = 20, cores = c(fits = 4, conditions = 1)) plotValues(best) } # }

code: # \donttest{   ## Generate a prediction function      times <- 0:5   grid <- data.frame(name = "A", time = times, row.names = paste0("p", times))   x <- Xd(grid, condition = "C1")      pars <- structure(rep(0, nrow(grid)), names = row.names(grid))      ## Simulate data   data.list <- lapply(1:3, function(i) {     prediction <- x(times, pars + rnorm(length(pars), 0, 1))     transform(as.data.frame(prediction), sigma = 1)   })      data <- as.datalist(do.call(rbind, data.list))      ## Generate objective function based on data and model   ## Then fit the data and plot the result   obj <- normL2(data, x)   myfit <- trust(obj, pars, rinit = 1, rmax = 10)   plot(x(times, myfit$argument), data)  # }

second derivatives forward over reverse, the default of em() dm <- c("forward", "reverse", "forward-reverse") x <- Xt() g <- Y(c(y = "amt * Ka / (V * Ka - Cl) * (exp(-Cl / V * time) - exp(-Ka * time))"),        states = "time", modelname = "theoph_obs", compile = FALSE, derivMode = dm,        outdir = tempdir()) #> Overwriting: /tmp/Rtmp8qFUqD/theoph_obs.cpp err <- Y(c(y = "sigma_add"), g, attachInput = FALSE, modelname = "theoph_err", compile = FALSE,          derivMode = dm, outdir = tempdir()) #> Overwriting: /tmp/Rtmp8qFUqD/theoph_err.cpp ## one condition per subject with the subject dose; the effect formula replaces each log parameter ## by an intercept plus a random effect per subject doses <- tapply(th$Dose * th$Wt, th$Subject, `[`, 1)[subjects] trafo <- branch(define(NULL, "x <- x", x = c("Ka", "V", "Cl", "amt", "sigma_add")),                 table = data.frame(ID = subjects, dose = doses, row.names = subjects)) trafo <- insert(trafo, "amt <- dose", dose = dose) trafo <- insert(trafo, "x <- exp(x)", x = c("Ka", "V", "Cl", "sigma_add")) p <- P(insert(trafo, Ka + V + Cl ~ 1 + (1 | ID)), method = "explicit", compile = FALSE,        modelname = "theoph_p", derivMode = dm, outdir = tempdir()) compile(g, err, p, output = tempfile("theoph")) #> using C++ compiler: g++ [-O2 -DNDEBUG -w -fPIC] #> reusing 14 unchanged object(s) obj <- normL2(data, g * x * p, errmodel = err) fit <- em(obj, randomEffects(p), init = c(Ka = 0, V = 3, Cl = 0.7, sigma_add = log(0.5)))  ## code: # \donttest{ old <- options(dMod2.outdir = tempdir())  ## Decay model, observation and parameter transformation, compiled together f <- addReaction(eqnlist(), from = "A", to = "", rate = "k*A") x <- Xs(odemodel(f, modelname = "profile_x", compile = FALSE)) g <- Y(c(y = "A"), f = x, attachInput = FALSE, modelname = "profile_g",        compile = FALSE) p <- P(eqnvec(A = "exp(logA)", k = "exp(logk)"), condition = "C1",        modelname = "profile_p", compile = FALSE) compile(x, g, p, output = "profile_example", cores = 1) #> using C++ compiler: g++ #>   every source : -O2 -DNDEBUG -w -fPIC #>   2 of 4 also  : -fopenmp  ## Data, objective and fit set.seed(1) times <- seq(0, 5, by = 0.5) data <- datalist(C1 = data.frame(   name = "y", time = times, sigma = 0.05,   value = 2 * exp(-0.5 * times) + rnorm(length(times), sd = 0.05))) obj <- normL2(data, g * x * p) myfit <- trust(obj, c(logA = 0, logk = 0), rinit = 1, rmax = 10)  ## Profiles by integration and by repeated optimization profiles.approx <- profile(obj, myfit$argument, whichPar = c("logA", "logk")) profiles.exact <- profile(obj, myfit$argument, whichPar = c("logA", "logk"),                           method = "optimize")  ## Plots and confidence intervals plotProfile(list(approx = profiles.approx, exact = profiles.exact))  plotPaths(profiles.approx, whichPar = "logk")  confint(profiles.approx, val.column = "value") #>      name      value      lower      upper #> logA logA  0.6774738  0.6369418  0.7167919 #> logk logk -0.7369431 -0.8051821 -0.6699116  options(old) # }

code: # \donttest{ ## Theophylline, 12 subjects: one-compartment model with first-order absorption in closed ## form, log parameters with a normal random intercept per subject, additive error th <- datasets::Theoph th$Subject <- as.character(th$Subject) subjects <- unique(th$Subject) data <- as.datalist(data.frame(name = "y", time = th$Time, value = th$conc, sigma = NA_real_,                                condition = th$Subject)) ## second derivatives forward over reverse, the default of em() dm <- c("forward", "reverse", "forward-reverse") x <- Xt() g <- Y(c(y = "amt * Ka / (V * Ka - Cl) * (exp(-Cl / V * time) - exp(-Ka * time))"),        states = "time", modelname = "theoph_obs", compile = FALSE, derivMode = dm,        outdir = tempdir()) #> Overwriting: /tmp/Rtmp8qFUqD/theoph_obs.cpp err <- Y(c(y = "sigma_add"), g, attachInput = FALSE, modelname = "theoph_err", compile = FALSE,          derivMode = dm, outdir = tempdir()) #> Overwriting: /tmp/Rtmp8qFUqD/theoph_err.cpp ## one condition per subject with the subject dose; the effect formula replaces each log parameter ## by an intercept plus a random effect per subject doses <- tapply(th$Dose * th$Wt, th$Subject, `[`, 1)[subjects] trafo <- branch(define(NULL, "x <- x", x = c("Ka", "V", "Cl", "amt", "sigma_add")),                 table = data.frame(ID = subjects, dose = doses, row.names = subjects)) trafo <- insert(trafo, "amt <- dose", dose = dose) trafo <- insert(trafo, "x <- exp(x)", x = c("Ka", "V", "Cl", "sigma_add")) p <- P(insert(trafo, Ka + V + Cl ~ 1 + (1 | ID)), method = "explicit", compile = FALSE,        modelname = "theoph_p", derivMode = dm, outdir = tempdir()) compile(g, err, p, output = tempfile("theoph")) #> using C++ compiler: g++ [-O2 -DNDEBUG -w -fPIC] #> reusing 14 unchanged object(s) obj <- normL2(data, g * x * p, errmodel = err) fit <- em(obj, randomEffects(p), init = c(Ka = 0, V = 3, Cl = 0.7, sigma_add = log(0.5)))  ## residuals in the order of the data rows of predict() pr <- predict(fit) pr <- pr[pr$source == "obs", ] head(data.frame(pr[c("condition", "time", "observed", "IPRED", "PRED")],                 IWRES = residuals(fit), CWRES = residuals(fit, type = "CWRES"),                 PWRES = residuals(fit, type = "PWRES"))) #>   condition time observed    IPRED     PRED      IWRES      CWRES      PWRES #> 1         1 0.00     0.74 0.000000 0.000000  1.0656621  1.0656621  1.0656621 #> 2         1 0.25     2.84 3.845625 3.262278 -1.4481847 -0.1771436 -0.6081158 #> 3         1 0.57     6.57 6.784953 5.829128 -0.3095509  1.0950932  1.0669177 #> 4         1 1.12    10.50 9.043486 7.864023  2.0975030  2.3313980  3.7960283 #> 5         1 2.02     9.66 9.784612 8.504583 -0.1794513 -0.6321836  1.6638977 #> 6         1 3.82     8.58 9.093280 7.620456 -0.7391657 -0.3220713  1.3818233  ## NPDE from 200 simulated data sets, with the tests of mean, variance and normality npde <- residuals(fit, type = "NPDE", nsim = 200, seed = 1) attr(npde, "tests") #>        test statistic           p #> 1      mean 0.8845372 0.378026872 #> 2  variance 0.8560526 0.236255368 #> 3 normality 0.9643513 0.001549586 #> 4    global        NA 0.004648758 # }

code: # \donttest{ ## Theophylline, 12 subjects: one-compartment model with first-order absorption in closed ## form, log parameters with a normal random intercept per subject, additive error th <- datasets::Theoph th$Subject <- as.character(th$Subject) subjects <- unique(th$Subject) data <- as.datalist(data.frame(name = "y", time = th$Time, value = th$conc, sigma = NA_real_,                                condition = th$Subject)) ## second derivatives forward over reverse, the default of em() dm <- c("forward", "reverse", "forward-reverse") x <- Xt() g <- Y(c(y = "amt * Ka / (V * Ka - Cl) * (exp(-Cl / V * time) - exp(-Ka * time))"),        states = "time", modelname = "theoph_obs", compile = FALSE, derivMode = dm,        outdir = tempdir()) #> Overwriting: /tmp/Rtmp8qFUqD/theoph_obs.cpp err <- Y(c(y = "sigma_add"), g, attachInput = FALSE, modelname = "theoph_err", compile = FALSE,          derivMode = dm, outdir = tempdir()) #> Overwriting: /tmp/Rtmp8qFUqD/theoph_err.cpp ## one condition per subject with the subject dose; the effect formula replaces each log parameter ## by an intercept plus a random effect per subject doses <- tapply(th$Dose * th$Wt, th$Subject, `[`, 1)[subjects] trafo <- branch(define(NULL, "x <- x", x = c("Ka", "V", "Cl", "amt", "sigma_add")),                 table = data.frame(ID = subjects, dose = doses, row.names = subjects)) trafo <- insert(trafo, "amt <- dose", dose = dose) trafo <- insert(trafo, "x <- exp(x)", x = c("Ka", "V", "Cl", "sigma_add")) p <- P(insert(trafo, Ka + V + Cl ~ 1 + (1 | ID)), method = "explicit", compile = FALSE,        modelname = "theoph_p", derivMode = dm, outdir = tempdir()) compile(g, err, p, output = tempfile("theoph")) #> using C++ compiler: g++ [-O2 -DNDEBUG -w -fPIC] #> reusing 14 unchanged object(s) obj <- normL2(data, g * x * p, errmodel = err) fit <- em(obj, randomEffects(p), init = c(Ka = 0, V = 3, Cl = 0.7, sigma_add = log(0.5)))  ## two data sets from the fit: random effects drawn per subject, noise from the error model sims <- simulate(fit, nsim = 2, seed = 1) head(as.data.frame(sims[[1]])) #>   name time      value sigma lloq condition #> 1    y 0.00 -0.2737965    NA -Inf         1 #> 2    y 0.25  2.4925352    NA -Inf         1 #> 3    y 0.57  5.5951301    NA -Inf         1 #> 4    y 1.12  7.6380937    NA -Inf         1 #> 5    y 2.02  8.2504030    NA -Inf         1 #> 6    y 3.82  7.6247819    NA -Inf         1  ## a refit to the first simulated data set, started at the estimates refit <- em(normL2(sims[[1]], g * x * p, errmodel = err), randomEffects(p), init = fit) rbind(fit = coef(fit), refit = coef(refit)) #>              Ka        V        Cl  sigma_add omega_Ka_Ka omega_V_V omega_Cl_Cl #> fit   0.4638825 3.459748 1.0121568 -0.3647014   -0.455224 -1.977427   -1.336115 #> refit 0.7119933 3.484717 0.9898651 -0.4233285   -1.035738 -1.767662   -1.835440 # }

second derivatives forward over reverse, the default of em() dm <- c("forward", "reverse", "forward-reverse") x <- Xt() g <- Y(c(y = "amt * Ka / (V * Ka - Cl) * (exp(-Cl / V * time) - exp(-Ka * time))"),        states = "time", modelname = "theoph_obs", compile = FALSE, derivMode = dm,        outdir = tempdir()) #> Overwriting: /tmp/Rtmp8qFUqD/theoph_obs.cpp err <- Y(c(y = "sigma_add"), g, attachInput = FALSE, modelname = "theoph_err", compile = FALSE,          derivMode = dm, outdir = tempdir()) #> Overwriting: /tmp/Rtmp8qFUqD/theoph_err.cpp ## one condition per subject with the subject dose; the effect formula replaces each log parameter ## by an intercept plus a random effect per subject doses <- tapply(th$Dose * th$Wt, th$Subject, `[`, 1)[subjects] trafo <- branch(define(NULL, "x <- x", x = c("Ka", "V", "Cl", "amt", "sigma_add")),                 table = data.frame(ID = subjects, dose = doses, row.names = subjects)) trafo <- insert(trafo, "amt <- dose", dose = dose) trafo <- insert(trafo, "x <- exp(x)", x = c("Ka", "V", "Cl", "sigma_add")) p <- P(insert(trafo, Ka + V + Cl ~ 1 + (1 | ID)), method = "explicit", compile = FALSE,        modelname = "theoph_p", derivMode = dm, outdir = tempdir()) compile(g, err, p, output = tempfile("theoph")) #> using C++ compiler: g++ [-O2 -DNDEBUG -w -fPIC] #> reusing 14 unchanged object(s) obj <- normL2(data, g * x * p, errmodel = err) init <- c(Ka = 0, V = 3, Cl = 0.7, sigma_add = log(0.5))  ## FOCEI fit, the estimates and the random effects per subject fit <- em(obj, randomEffects(p), init = init) fit #> EM (focei): -2 log L 359.403186, converged TRUE, 10 iterations, 12 groups #>          Ka           V          Cl   sigma_add omega_Ka_Ka   omega_V_V  #>   0.4638825   3.4597479   1.0121568  -0.3647014  -0.4552240  -1.9774269  #> omega_Cl_Cl  #>  -1.3361153  #> Random effects: #>  type eta1 eta2  estimate         se #>    sd   Ka   Ka 0.6343058 0.14972302 #>    sd    V    V 0.1384250 0.04075699 #>    sd   Cl   Cl 0.2628648 0.06586477 summary(fit) #> EM summary (focei): -2 log L 359.403186, converged TRUE, 10 iterations #>   without the 2 pi constant of the data (NONMEM OBJ): 116.803413 #>  #> Parameters: #>             estimate      se rsePct #> Ka            0.4639 0.19180 41.350 #> V             3.4600 0.04718  1.364 #> Cl            1.0120 0.08333  8.233 #> sigma_add    -0.3647 0.07268 19.930 #> omega_Ka_Ka  -0.4552 0.23600 51.850 #> omega_V_V    -1.9770 0.29440 14.890 #> omega_Cl_Cl  -1.3360 0.25060 18.750 #> Standard errors without the curvature of the prediction in the random effects within the volume term (forward over reverse; deriv2 = TRUE gives the full one) #>  #> Random effects: #>  type eta1 eta2 estimate      se #>    sd   Ka   Ka   0.6343 0.14970 #>    sd    V    V   0.1384 0.04076 #>    sd   Cl   Cl   0.2629 0.06586 #>  #> Shrinkage: eta_Ka = 0.018, eta_V = 0.103, eta_Cl = 0.039  fit$omega #>   type eta1 eta2  estimate         se #> 1   sd   Ka   Ka 0.6343058 0.14972302 #> 2   sd    V    V 0.1384250 0.04075699 #> 3   sd   Cl   Cl 0.2628648 0.06586477 head(fit$random) #>   group eta parameter        mode        se #> 1     1  Ka  eta_Ka_1  0.08621976 0.1515854 #> 2     2  Ka  eta_Ka_2  0.19818408 0.1725709 #> 3     3  Ka  eta_Ka_3  0.37186008 0.1810720 #> 4     4  Ka  eta_Ka_4 -0.28173371 0.1640986 #> 5     5  Ka  eta_Ka_5 -0.04271272 0.1461175 #> 6     6  Ka  eta_Ka_6 -0.38568935 0.2043190  ## quadrature started from the FOCEI estimates, and SAEM fitQ <- em(obj, randomEffects(p), init = fit, method = "quadrature", verbose = FALSE) fitS <- em(obj, randomEffects(p), init = init, method = "saem", verbose = FALSE) c(focei = fit$value, quadrature = fitQ$value, saem = fitS$value) #>      focei quadrature       saem  #>   359.4032   360.7548   360.7624  # } if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{ ##
